pvp_totems.name: Grounding Totem
pvp_totems.what: 5 hp totem; redirects one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 s. Not AoE spells. Lasts 45 s, 15 s cooldown, 6% base mana.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Use against spellcasters (Icy Veins). Skill Capped: save it for the one spell that matters.

pvp_totems.name: Tremor Totem
pvp_totems.what: 5 hp totem; removes Fear, Charm and Sleep from party members within 30 yd. Lasts 5 min, no cooldown, 60 mana.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Gets your healer (and you) out of Fear; Fear is the Warlock's CC per Skill Capped.
pvp_totems.flag: Pulse interval not in Forever tooltip; Icy Veins Elemental/Resto leveling say every 2 s, Enhancement leveling says every 5 s.

pvp_totems.name: Earthbind Totem
pvp_totems.what: 5 hp totem for 45 s; Earthbind slows enemies within 10 yd by 50% (5 s debuff, refreshed). 15 s cooldown, 6% base mana. Elemental talent Earthbound (Icy Veins: level 25 pick) makes it root for 5 s.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Kite melee and escape; with Earthbound it roots.

pvp_totems.name: Stoneclaw Totem
pvp_totems.what: Rank 1: 206 hp totem for 15 s; taunts creatures within 8 yd. 30 s cooldown.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Taunts creatures only (pets/mobs), not players. Wowhead leveling: use vs multiple enemies to pull them off you.

pvp_totems.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
pvp_totems.what: Removes 1 poison from party members within 30 yd every 5 s. Lasts 5 min, 10% base mana.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Party poison cleanse every 5 s (PvP use not stated by source).

pvp_totems.name: Disease Cleansing Totem
pvp_totems.what: Removes 1 disease from party members within 30 yd every 5 s. Lasts 5 min, 10% base mana.
pvp_totems.pvp_use: Party disease cleanse every 5 s (PvP use not stated by source).

pvp_tips.title: Earth Shock to interrupt
pvp_tips.body: Earth Shock interrupts a cast and locks that spell school for 2 s. Save it for heals or big casts. All Shocks share a 6 s cooldown, so each Shock has an opportunity cost.

pvp_tips.title: Frost Shock to kite
pvp_tips.body: Frost Shock slows the target 50% for 8 s. Use it to kite melee or stop a runner.

pvp_tips.title: Grounding vs casters
pvp_tips.body: Grounding Totem (30) redirects one harmful spell aimed at you or your party (every 10 s, not AoE). Icy Veins: great vs spellcasters.

pvp_tips.title: Tremor vs fear
pvp_tips.body: Tremor Totem (18) removes Fear, Charm and Sleep from party within 30 yd. Skill Capped: use it to get your healer out of Fear.

pvp_tips.title: Earthbind to escape
pvp_tips.body: Earthbind Totem slows enemies within 10 yd by 50%; with the Earthbound talent it roots for 5 s. Good for escaping melee.

pvp_tips.title: Purge their buffs
pvp_tips.body: Purge removes a magic buff (rank 1: one effect). Strip shields (Mage, Priest) and heal-over-time effects.

pvp_tips.title: Ghost Wolf to run
pvp_tips.body: Ghost Wolf (20) gives +40% run speed with no cooldown. Improved Ghost Wolf makes it instant.
pvp_tips.flag: Icy Veins frames it as travel/mobility, not explicitly a PvP escape.

pvp_tips.title: Stoneform vs melee and DoTs
pvp_tips.body: Stoneform removes and blocks Poison, Bleed and Disease and cuts Physical damage 10% for 8 s. Icy Veins: nice vs melee; the cleanse helps in 1v1.

pvp_tips.title: Lesser Healing Wave for fast heals
pvp_tips.body: In PvP, heal with Lesser Healing Wave (1.5 s cast) rather than slow Healing Wave; use Nature's Swiftness for an instant big heal.
pvp_tips.flag: Classic (not Forever) Icy Veins PvP guide.

pvp_tips.title: No real CC: lean on utility
pvp_tips.body: Shaman lacks a Polymorph/Sap/Fear equivalent; win with slows, interrupts, Purge and totems.
pvp_tips.flag: Skill Capped is a third-party site, not on the preferred list.

stoneform.what: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison and Disease effects; reduces Physical damage taken by 10%.
stoneform.forever_change: Classic gave +10% armor (not -10% physical damage taken) and immunity; Forever adds instant removal and swaps armor for 10% physical damage reduction.
stoneform.does_not: Does not remove Magic or Curse effects in Forever (that was added in retail 6.0.2).

ruleset_detection.notes: No source documents an in-game API that returns the Forever ruleset (Normal/PvP/RP/Hardcore). C_GameRules.GetActiveGameMode exists in the Forever client but returns Enum.GameMode (Standard/Plunderstorm/WoWHack), not the ruleset. A code search of Ketho/wow-ui-source-forever for Ruleset/GetRuleSet/IsPvPRealm/GetServerPVPType found only chat-channel, spell-diminish and login-screen (waitingForRuleSets, superDistrict) uses; nothing an addon can query in-world. Icy Veins: rulesets replace realm types; PvP ruleset auto-flags you in Contested/Enemy zones (any zone above level 15 is contested), others need /pvp. Practical options: parse GetRealmName() (observed ids like ...Realm6PvP) or infer from UnitIsPVP('player') while in a contested zone without having typed /pvp; both are undocumented heuristics.
ruleset_detection.flag: GitHub code search (gh search code) is not a listed source; it was used only to look for absence of an API.
